release_notes: Orbitra 2.0: an AI assistant inside the panel — bring your own key (GLM, Gemini, OpenAI, Claude, DeepSeek, OpenRouter, Ollama), pick a model from your provider's list, ask for reports or changes in plain words; every change waits for your confirmation. Campaign rules: notify, pause the campaign or switch an offer off in the split when spend, sales or ROI cross your thresholds; auto-optimisation reports weight changes to Telegram. Text A/B tests on local landings with AI-written variants. Compare with the previous period in the campaign list. Bot stream filter gets a strictness choice (Soft / Balanced / Strict; Balanced for new filters and Keitaro imports, Strict kept for existing ones) and logs why a visit counted as a bot; the Click API client kclient.php now forwards the browser language, which sent all API traffic into bot streams before (re-download kclient.php). Keitaro import maps source, ISP, User-Agent, search engine and other filters instead of dropping them, and an 'empty' language value matches visitors whose browser sent no language again. New User-Agent filter, * masks and /regex/ in Referer and User-Agent, CIDR and a-b ranges in the IP filter. Night-mode themes keep your colour scheme; click ids are UUIDv7 now, for fewer disk writes under load.
